datasets.title: Central African Republic Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 115.8 thousand km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 47 % of the total road length in the dataset region. The average age of data for the region is 4 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 2% of roads were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en highway surface smoothness width lanes oneway bridge layer source name:fr name:sg This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_caf_roads]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Road network data collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information contributions, exported and processed by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) using raw-data-api. Data includes approximately 115.8 thousand km of mapped roads with attributes such as surface type, lanes, and bridge presence, representing approximately 47% of estimated total road length in the region.
